summary: Every legal input has at most nine decimal digits, which is too narrow for an honest runtime scaling verdict.

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference scans the d-digit representation to select the maximum remapping and constructs two d-digit transformed values, so all work is linear in d.
Regression compares every input from 1 through 10000 and representative eight- and nine-digit boundaries with an independent oracle that enumerates all 100 remappings.
